condition: at least one exact symmetric width/hold variant has median gross return > 0 across the six deterministic candidates

branch_A_short_symmetric_pass.forbidden: no width/hold/quiet-threshold change before expanded result

branch_B_short_symmetric_fail.condition: no branch_A variant satisfies the pass condition

action.signal: unchanged finalized public USDG DLMMMint after <=2 prior-30m swaps and >=10 prior-24h swaps
action.geometry: copy the public signal mint's exact bin set and sidedness/distribution, scaled non-impact to governed paper capital
action.rationale: pre-result historical quiet-USDG hold distribution; public mint geometry is observable at signal time
action.size: 0.5% of exact local active/range liquidity, capped by executable unwind
action.exit: exact full removal plus executable same-pool residual unwind

forbidden: do not select pools by future return
do not add a directional signal after observing outcomes

prerequisite: positive median and mean after conservative costs
no single pool contributes >40% of positive PnL
freeze_and_holdout.then: freeze exact signal/range/hold/size rule before opening final 20% chronological holdout
final_profitability_claim: >=3 holdout pools unless strategy is explicitly frozen as pool-specific
